cases.condition: No strict portable DeepMD layout manifest is available.
cases.minimum_next_action: Create the exact layout manifest without reading or embedding private array payloads.

cases.condition: Version, backend, ordered type map, or type-file identity differs.
cases.minimum_next_action: Normalize the exact provider identity and ordered type-map evidence before continuing.

cases.condition: Array metadata, periodic box, virial policy, group isolation, source-frame index, or split coverage fails.
cases.minimum_next_action: Regenerate the first failed metadata layer with a trusted array-header and grouping adapter.

cases.condition: Layout metadata passes but array, protocol, acceptance, and license bytes remain unresolved.
cases.minimum_next_action: Freeze a portable training projection bound to the exact layout-audit hash.

cases.condition: Layout report, environment, or version-generated provider schema is absent or detached.
cases.minimum_next_action: Bind the first missing exact upstream, environment, or provider-schema hash.

cases.condition: Backend training capability, descriptor, fitting, learning rate, loss, cadence, thresholds, or restart lineage fails.
cases.minimum_next_action: Correct the first explicit projection finding without using a DeepMD default.

cases.condition: The portable projection passed and rendering or training is requested.
cases.minimum_next_action: Obtain a trusted version-bound adapter and authorization for the exact projected action.

cases.condition: A run claim lacks external authorization, execution, rendered-config, output-log, or dataset-lineage identity.
cases.minimum_next_action: Provide the exact trusted execution evidence that binds the rendered config and outcome.

cases.condition: Exit, status, final step, nonfinite sentinel, artifacts, metrics, evidence-role separation, or restart parent fails.
cases.minimum_next_action: Preserve the failed run record and diagnose before planning a separately authorized retry.

cases.condition: Technical run metadata passes but no frozen unloaded model manifest is available.
cases.minimum_next_action: Create a frozen-model manifest bound to the exact audited source checkpoint.

cases.condition: Model artifact, checkpoint, run/config, source dataset, units, energy convention, provider schema, evidence-role separation, or licenses fail.
cases.minimum_next_action: Repair the first exact frozen-model lineage finding without loading the artifact.

cases.condition: Frozen-model metadata passes but independent generic test and OOD evidence is absent.
cases.minimum_next_action: Obtain authorization for a safe provider-specific evaluator and hand off to the generic independent-test gates.

cases.condition: No earlier condition can be established uniquely from the exact available evidence.
cases.minimum_next_action: Stop and obtain the smallest exact evidence needed to select one earlier case unambiguously.
